audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 with Brand owning every phase matches a ranged burn mage vs a peel tank with no ranged poke of his own.
Spikes correctly track level 2 burst before his passive stacks, level 6 Pyroclasm ignoring E's directional shield, first item percent burn through his high base resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Unbreakable as matchup-defining with no cooldown number (lint). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint). missingInteractions flags that Brand's Pillar of Flame (W) denies Braum's Stand Behind Me (W) leap, which isn't mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Unbreakable's real cooldown is 16/14/12/10/8s; Stand Behind Me is a dash (enemyKit flags it 'dash'), and Brand's W creates terrain/zone that blocks dashes per ownerKit flags, so Pillar of Flame denies the leap when timed on the cast.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries the real Unbreakable numbers and the W-denies-W interaction. Dos/don'ts de-duplicated with distinct, grounded content.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E-Q stun package answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Unbreakable (E): 16/14/12/10/8s CD — eats one poke or engage projectile from its facing; wait it out or flank it. - Your W (Pillar) shuts off his Stand Behind Me (W) leap — hold it for the engage, not chip. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Trade whenever his shield direction is wrong — Unbreakable only blocks the side it's raised toward.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Unbreakable up (16-8s CD) means your poke gets eaten — bait it first, then commit.
